_comment: E5 increment 3, Step 3b. Two rule objects, PREPARED ARTIFACTS only — not yet folded into any pack. (1) el.e33g.income-60k-manual, renamed el.e33g.remote-work-configuration: the duplicate-subtree AND(X,X) collapsed to a single X, and the dishonest 'income-60k' name/reason_code (it tested zero income facts) replaced with an honest one describing what the when-clause actually tests. (2) review.e33g.income-evidence: NEW HUMAN_REVIEW rule, product-scoped to E33G, same 4 remote-work facts, so E33G can no longer reach SUPPORTED with zero income evidence — per apps/backend-rag/backend/services/visa_engine/evaluator.py:624-634, a TRUE product-scoped HUMAN_REVIEW rule forces ProductProofStatus.REVIEW and is evaluated BEFORE the ELIGIBILITY stage's true_support is consulted, so this rule overrides el.e33g.remote-work's unconditional SUPPORT for the same facts (verified live this session, not assumed).

rules._change_from_seq7: rule_id renamed from el.e33g.income-60k-manual; `when` deduped from all(all(4 facts), all(SAME 4 facts)) to all(4 facts) — the outer duplicate-subtree removed, inner content unchanged, so required_facts is unchanged; effect.reason_code renamed from E33G_INCOME_60K_ADVISOR_CHECK (named a check the when-clause never performed) to E33G_REMOTE_WORK_CONFIGURATION_ELIGIBLE (names what the when-clause actually tests). source_refs, covered_purposes, on_unknown, product_version_ids, priority, valid_period, safety_critical all preserved verbatim from seq-7.

rules._new_rule_rationale: OD-1 pattern: the USD 60,000/year income floor (CL-E33G-02, VERIFIED-WITH-CAVEAT) is un-modelable — no `work.*` or other FactPath carries an income amount (Anchors, spec Step 3b: 'no work-income fact'; secondhome.passive_monthly_income_usd is passive income, semantically wrong for a remote worker's salary). Rather than silently letting the same 4 configuration facts grant unconditional SUPPORT (which is exactly what el.e33g.remote-work already does, unconditionally, on these same facts), this rule routes the SAME condition to REQUIRE_REVIEW so a human confirms the income evidence before the product can be treated as settled. source_refs are the SAME framing-only citations (6f5135f2 Kepmen M.IP-08.GR.01.01/2025, 9248b1d7 Permenkumham 22/2023 jo 11/2024) already used on every other e33g.* rule in seq-7 — no pack source_record independently backs the USD 60,000 figure at primary-law level (CL-E33G-02's own caveat: sourced from an internal Bali Zero operational guide, not a Kepmen/Permenkumham article pinpoint); this is disclosed, not invented. See cure-e33g.md for the QW-4a reason-code contract note (E33G_INCOME_EVIDENCE_REVIEW is a NEW code, not yet in REVIEW_REASON_COPY or KNOWN_UNMAPPED_REVIEW_REASON_CODES — documented as a concrete edit to apply when seq-9 assembly lands this rule in a real pack, per the QW-4a test's own construction which globs the actual pack file and would otherwise flag a phantom KNOWN_UNMAPPED entry if added prematurely).
